meta.name: WeOpen Redy Color Tokens
meta.description: Core Redy brand palette plus lightweight project accent colors for WeMail, WeGit, and WeOpen.

redyRust.$description: Redy primary rust-red fur and main brand emphasis.

cream.$description: Cream fur, inner ear, face mask, and soft neutral surfaces.

charcoal.$description: Dark straps, text, structural details, and high-contrast foregrounds.

gitGreen.$description: Small Git, terminal, lens reflection, and interaction accents only.

warmRice.$description: Warm page background and neutral display surface.

softBrown.$description: Soft outline, leather, ring, and gentle structural strokes.

cloudMist.$description: Cloud-mist blue gray for mail, inbox, and private delivery cues.

coolLight.$description: Cool white-blue highlight for mail cards and envelope surfaces.

waxSeal.$description: Restrained wax-seal red-brown detail for trust and delivery marks.

branchGreen.$description: Primary WeGit accent, reused from Redy's Git green.

graphTint.$description: Soft branch graph fill and quiet commit-node surface.

graphDark.$description: Deep green-gray for branch structure and technical contrast.

platformRice.$description: Warm platform neutral for dashboard, module, and organization surfaces.

panelBrown.$description: Muted panel brown for platform frames and modular cards.

rustExtension.$description: Small Redy-rust extension for mother-brand continuity.
